first_routes.purpose: Explain the game without promising entitlement.
Convert invisible work into public proof.
Review agent proposals before any public projection.
Expose futarchy-ready questions and approved public proposal projections.

archetypes.name: Prototyper
archetypes.organism_function: Generates new products, mechanisms, narratives and market questions.
archetypes.current_expression: Odysseum, GASdf, Ignis, ASDFASDFA/CYNIC maps, new axioms.
archetypes.failure_mode: Too many futures, not enough public proof.

archetypes.name: Builder
archetypes.organism_function: Turns a promising prototype into production-grade infra or product.
archetypes.current_expression: Kernel, organs, MCP/REST coordination, foundation contracts, public-ui scaffold.
archetypes.failure_mode: Shipping internal machinery that nobody can inspect.

archetypes.name: Sweeper
archetypes.organism_function: Simplifies, deletes, clarifies, compresses and makes the system legible.
archetypes.current_expression: Topology policy, forbidden readings, claim ladder, interface contract.

archetypes.name: Grower
archetypes.organism_function: Improves PMF, distribution, onboarding, proof loops and user action.
archetypes.current_expression: Bagwork loop, build-proof stream, decision board, Odysseum ICP.
archetypes.failure_mode: Distribution dies while engineering compounds privately.

archetypes.name: Maintainer
archetypes.organism_function: Keeps mature surfaces secure, reliable, fast and legally coherent.
archetypes.current_expression: Gate system, source-of-truth hierarchy, fair launch, token/equity firewall.
archetypes.failure_mode: Stability consumes all energy before product clarity emerges.

current_balance.interface_priority: Act as a Sweeper organ before acting as a growth surface.

active_axioms.name: FIDELITY
active_axioms.product_question: Does the system say what it actually is?
active_axioms.interface_obligation: Names, claims and roles must match the real rail.

active_axioms.name: PHI
active_axioms.product_question: Is the system proportionate and harmonized?
active_axioms.interface_obligation: Screens must show relationships, not isolated hype objects.

active_axioms.name: VERIFY
active_axioms.product_question: Can a stranger inspect the claim?
active_axioms.interface_obligation: Every claim needs a primary source or must be downgraded.

active_axioms.name: CULTURE
active_axioms.product_question: Does this preserve the community's living pattern?
active_axioms.interface_obligation: The interface must leave room for cult energy, replies, pressure and lore.

active_axioms.name: BURN
active_axioms.product_question: Is the structure efficient and non-extractive?
active_axioms.interface_obligation: Remove routes, copy, visuals and claims that do not move proof or decisions.

active_axioms.name: SOVEREIGNTY
active_axioms.product_question: Does this preserve autonomous decision capacity?
active_axioms.interface_obligation: Separate legal, protocol, operator, market and narrative power.

observed_axioms.name: KENOSIS
observed_axioms.interface_obligation: Leave intentional space where forcing action would capture autonomy or deplete the operator.

observed_axioms.name: FRACTAL
observed_axioms.interface_obligation: Preserve the raw event -> judgment -> public projection pattern across scales.

archetype_axiom_matrix.must_prove: New possibilities are alive, but not overclaimed.
A prototype became inspectable infrastructure or product.
Complexity was reduced and claims now match reality.
Distribution creates agency without coercion or fake promises.
The system remains reliable, bounded and auditable.

kenosis_protocol.purpose: Prevent overproduction, overthinking and environmental accumulation from masquerading as productive work.
trigger_signals: adding a new contract before deciding the canonical owner
adding UI before the proof object exists
continuing to reason after the next action is already known
physical workspace accumulation starts reducing energy
LLM proposes extra structure that does not delete ambiguity
kenosis_protocol.resume_question: What should be deleted, downgraded or left intentionally empty before adding anything else?

audiences.name: Builder
audiences.need: Understand what exists, what can be inspected, and where to contribute.

audiences.name: Investor or partner
audiences.need: Distinguish company, protocol, token, operator, and proof boundaries.

audiences.name: Onchain user
audiences.need: Verify claims through artifacts, transactions, contracts, and public state.

audiences.name: Operator
audiences.need: See what must happen next without reading the whole organism.

what_we_want: A public interface that feels like an operating console, not a pitch deck.
A corporate surface that explains Talaria, CYNIC, Odysseum, Ignis, and token boundaries cleanly.
A proof surface where every claim can become a file, command output, contract address, transaction, or redacted kernel observation.
A design language that borrows Solana's inspectability patterns without copying its explorer.
what_we_must_do: Separate public proof, private execution, corporate narrative, and blockchain state.
Label every object as public, private, draft, blocked, or unknown.
Never imply a live integration, token right, company promise, or verified transaction unless there is a public artifact.
Make the first screen answer: what is this, what can I inspect, what is still missing, and why should I trust the boundary.
what_we_refuse: Mystical organism language as the primary interface.
Marketing claims that are not externally observable.
A single undifferentiated dashboard that mixes company, protocol, and kernel concerns.

emotional_targets.interface_signal: Plain labels, boundary maps, visible unknowns.
Operator lanes, next actions, status tags, deterministic navigation.
Public artifacts, source references, redacted private areas, no unsupported claims.
Corporate polish, Solana-native cues, and a sense that a single operator can run serious infrastructure.
